# Amir-Shokat.github.io

Personal website and online CV of Amirmahdi Shokatabadi: plain HTML/CSS/JS, no build step.

* `index.html`: all content (experience, projects, research, education, skills)
* `styles.css`: light and dark themes, a mobile layout and a print stylesheet (the print button saves the page as a CV PDF)
* `assets/img/`: figures generated by the project repositories

## Publish on GitHub Pages

1. Create a public repository named exactly `Amir-Shokat.github.io`.
2. Push this folder to its `main` branch.
3. The site is served at <https://amir-shokat.github.io> (Settings > Pages > Deploy from branch `main`, folder `/`).

Preview locally: `python3 -m http.server 8000`, then open <http://localhost:8000>.
